dnssec_validation_enabled.title: DNSSEC Validation Enabled
dnssec_validation_enabled.description: Whether the resolver is configured to perform DNSSEC cryptographic validation on DNS responses

dnssec_validation_setting.title: DNSSEC Validation Setting Value
dnssec_validation_setting.description: The explicit configured value for DNSSEC validation enforcement

trust_anchors_configured.title: DNSSEC Trust Anchors Configured
trust_anchors_configured.description: Whether valid DNSSEC trust anchors (e.g., root zone KSK) are configured on the resolver, which are required for validation to function

recursion_access_policy.title: Recursion Access Policy
recursion_access_policy.description: Defines which source IPs or networks are permitted to send recursive queries to the resolver. 'open' means any source IP is accepted; 'restricted' means only explicitly authorized clients/networks are allowed.

rate_limiting_enabled.title: Response Rate Limiting Enabled
rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether the resolver enforces response rate limiting (RRL) or query rate limiting to mitigate amplification abuse

authorized_client_networks.title: Authorized Client Networks
authorized_client_networks.description: List of CIDR ranges explicitly authorized to send recursive queries. An empty list indicates no restrictions have been configured.

upstream_transport_protocol.title: Upstream Forwarding Transport Protocol
upstream_transport_protocol.description: The transport protocol used when forwarding DNS queries to upstream resolvers. Secure options are DoT or DoH; insecure options are plain UDP or TCP.

certificate_validation_enforced.title: Upstream TLS Certificate Validation Enforced
certificate_validation_enforced.description: Whether the resolver validates the TLS certificate presented by the upstream resolver. False if certificate validation is disabled or not configured despite DoT/DoH being nominally enabled.

source_port_randomization_enabled.title: Source Port Randomization Enabled
source_port_randomization_enabled.description: Whether the DNS resolver randomizes the source port for outgoing queries (0-65535 range), a primary defense against Kaminsky-style cache poisoning.

transaction_id_randomization_enabled.title: Transaction ID Randomization Enabled
transaction_id_randomization_enabled.description: Whether the DNS resolver uses cryptographically strong randomization for DNS transaction IDs (TXID), preventing predictable ID guessing attacks.

dnssec_validation_enforced.title: DNSSEC Validation Enforced (Cache Poisoning Context)
dnssec_validation_enforced.description: Whether the resolver enforces DNSSEC validation on responses, providing cryptographic integrity and significantly mitigating cache poisoning even if port/TXID randomization is weak.

negative_cache_ttl_seconds.title: Negative Cache TTL (seconds)
negative_cache_ttl_seconds.description: The maximum TTL in seconds applied to cached NXDOMAIN (negative) responses. High values prolong the effect of poisoned negative responses and delay recovery after DNS changes.

negative_ttl_cap_enforced.title: Negative TTL Cap Enforced
negative_ttl_cap_enforced.description: Whether the resolver enforces an operator-defined upper bound cap on negative cache TTL, overriding values from authoritative responses.

zone_transfer_acl_configured.title: Zone Transfer ACL Configured
zone_transfer_acl_configured.description: Whether an access control list restricting zone transfer (AXFR/IXFR) requests by source IP is configured on the DNS server.

tsig_authentication_enabled.title: TSIG Authentication Enabled for Zone Transfers
tsig_authentication_enabled.description: Whether TSIG (Transaction SIGnature) shared-secret authentication is required for all AXFR/IXFR zone transfer requests.

resolver_process_user.title: Resolver Process User Account
resolver_process_user.description: The OS user account under which the DNS resolver process runs (e.g., 'root', 'named', 'bind', 'unbound').

resolver_process_effective_uid.title: Resolver Process Effective UID
resolver_process_effective_uid.description: The numeric effective user ID of the running DNS resolver process. UID 0 indicates root; values below a site-defined threshold may indicate system or privileged accounts.

resolver_dedicated_service_account_confi.title: Dedicated Low-Privilege Service Account Configured
resolver_dedicated_service_account_confi.description: Whether the resolver is explicitly configured to run under a dedicated, non-privileged service account rather than a generic or privileged account.

rrl_responses_per_second.title: RRL Responses Per Second Limit
rrl_responses_per_second.description: The maximum number of identical or similar responses per second allowed per client IP before rate limiting kicks in. A value of 0 or very high values effectively disable rate limiting.

trust_anchor_auto_update_enabled.title: Trust Anchor Auto-Update Enabled
trust_anchor_auto_update_enabled.description: Whether the DNS resolver is configured to automatically update DNSSEC trust anchors (e.g., RFC 5011 automatic key rollover for root KSK).

trust_anchor_last_updated_days_ago.title: Days Since Trust Anchor Last Updated
trust_anchor_last_updated_days_ago.description: Number of days since the DNSSEC trust anchor (root KSK) was last updated or verified. High values indicate potential staleness relative to key rollover schedules.

dnssec_validation_mode.title: DNSSEC Validation Mode
dnssec_validation_mode.description: The configured DNSSEC validation enforcement mode of the resolver. 'enforcing' rejects invalid responses, 'permissive' logs but allows invalid responses, 'disabled' performs no DNSSEC validation.

query_logging_enabled.title: DNS Query Logging Enabled
query_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether the DNS resolver is configured to log individual DNS queries and responses.

logged_fields.title: Logged Query/Response Fields
logged_fields.description: List of fields captured per DNS log entry (e.g., timestamp, client_ip, query_name, query_type, response_code, response_data, ttl).

log_retention_days.title: DNS Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days DNS query/response logs are retained before deletion or rotation.

version_has_known_cve.title: Version Has Known CVE
version_has_known_cve.description: Whether the installed resolver software version has one or more publicly disclosed CVEs affecting parsing, validation, or protocol handling.

days_since_last_patch.title: Days Since Last Security Patch
days_since_last_patch.description: Number of days elapsed since the resolver software was last updated with a security patch or release.

patch_management_enabled.title: Automated Patch Management Enabled
patch_management_enabled.description: Whether an automated patch or update mechanism is configured and active for the DNS resolver software.

query_acl_allows_any.title: Query ACL Permits Any Source
query_acl_allows_any.description: Whether the resolver's ACL for recursive/authoritative queries is configured to permit requests from any IP address (e.g., allow-query { any; } in BIND).

permitted_query_source_ranges.title: Permitted Query Source Network Ranges
permitted_query_source_ranges.description: List of CIDR ranges explicitly allowed to send queries to the resolver. Presence of 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 indicates unrestricted access.

dns_rebinding_filter_enabled.title: DNS Rebinding Filter Enabled
dns_rebinding_filter_enabled.description: Indicates whether the resolver actively filters responses containing private/loopback/link-local addresses (RFC 1918, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1, 169.254.0.0/16, etc.) for publicly-named domains.

private_address_response_policy.title: Private Address Response Policy
private_address_response_policy.description: Describes the resolver's configured policy for handling DNS responses that contain private/loopback addresses for non-private domain names.

response_policy_zone_configured.title: Response Policy Zone (RPZ) Configured for Private Ranges
response_policy_zone_configured.description: Indicates whether a Response Policy Zone (RPZ) or equivalent mechanism is configured to intercept and neutralize answers containing private IP addresses for public domain queries.

chroot_jail_enabled.title: Chroot Jail Enabled
chroot_jail_enabled.description: Whether the resolver process is confined within a chroot jail directory, restricting its filesystem view to a subtree.

container_namespace_isolated.title: Container or Kernel Namespace Isolation Applied
container_namespace_isolated.description: Whether the resolver process runs inside a container or dedicated Linux namespaces that restrict host filesystem access.

mac_profile_enforced.title: Mandatory Access Control Profile Enforced
mac_profile_enforced.description: Whether a Mandatory Access Control profile (SELinux policy, AppArmor profile, seccomp filter) is actively enforced for the resolver process.
